title: statistics
description: Contains statistics about each attribute. Statistics are useful to estimate attribute distribution and range.

min.description: (Conservative) minimum attribute value for the entire layer.

max.description: (Conservative) maximum attribute value for the entire layer.

sum.description: Sum of the attribute values over the entire layer.

avg.description: Representing average or mean value. For example, sum/count.

mostFrequentValues.description: An array of most frequently used values within the point cloud scene layer.
